description: Filter by List is a Power BI Visual that allows users to apply filter values to a report in bulk instead of having to individually check each box in the filter pane. By default, to filter a report with many categories, users need to individually check each box in the filter pane. This is a tremendously time-consuming task when you have 100s of products, which is a common scenario for many clients. Filter by List lets you apply: an Inclusion filter: add the whole list of products into the slicer visual to instantly filter by them. an Exclusion filter: paste the values you don't want to see into the slicer visual to display the rest. Filter by List uses a flexible pricing model based on your needs and a free version that lets users filter up to 20 values. Limitations apply when a user shares a filtered report using Filter by list: If a user with a license shares a filtered report with another user with a license, both will be able to interact with the report. If a user with a license shares a filtered report with more than 20 items, with another user without a license, the latter will only be able to use the current saved filters or create new filters up to 20 values.
